overview.title: What changes in the network view mean
overview.summary: The overview tells you whether the DPRK sanctions network is expanding, consolidating, or reorganizing. Drift is most meaningful when a score is supported by provenance and repeat appearances in source reporting.
overview.tour_text: Use the overview to decide which years and entities merit a closer look, then open the Network Drift tab for structure-level interpretation.

network-drift.title: What network drift means
network-drift.summary: Network drift is a composite measure of how much an entity changed role between time slices. It combines embedding change, neighbor turnover, centrality movement, and community reassignment. UMAP movement is a visual aid only and is not the drift score itself.
network-drift.tour_text: Inspect the force graph, then read the heatmap and UMAP view together. Use the drift score to rank attention, not to replace source-level analysis.

glossary.definition: Composite change in an entity's network role across adjacent time slices.
How much an entity's direct counterparties changed between slices.
How much an entity became more or less of a broker in the network.
Whether an entity appears to have shifted into a different cluster of actors.
A 2D projection used to visualize structure. It helps interpretation but does not define the drift score.

overview: Use the growth chart to see whether the network is adding relationships over time.
Treat top drifters as leads for deeper provenance review, not as finished judgments.
network-drift: Read the force graph for local structure, the heatmap for trend persistence, and UMAP for broad movement patterns.
A high drift score matters most when multiple signals move together.
UMAP separation can reveal clusters visually, but the score comes from graph metrics and embeddings.

overview: Use the drift ranking to choose which entities to investigate first.
Jump to provenance once a drift alert appears meaningful.
network-drift: Prioritize entities with sustained drift across several transitions.
Investigate high centrality drift for signs of bridge emergence or broker behavior.
Cross-check a drift alert against source documents before escalating it as an analytic conclusion.
